Elena — thanks for the quick responses on the teams. We can approve a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to one team (applied to your primary account AEA-9987) under the following conditions:

1) You submit a PO referencing AE-9987 (Ben will send a template).
2) You verify corporate SSO for alphaedge.ai so we can tie the other signups to your org.
3) You agree to consolidate the three project accounts into the primary account within 30 days of PO acceptance.

If those conditions are met and we receive the PO within 14 days, we'll provision the credit within 48 hours. If consolidation is not completed in 30 days, we reserve the right to retract the extra credit.

Next steps: Ben will send the PO template; Marissa and I can assist with consolidation steps if you want a technical walkthrough. If you'd prefer a smaller, immediate credit to one additional team without consolidation, let us know and we'll process that instead (but we won't extend credits to all separate trial accounts).

Best,
